verses.text: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.
verses.title: Inviting God’s Peace

verses.text: BOOK I Psalms 1–41 Psalm 1 Blessed is the one who does not walk in step with the wicked or stand in the way that sinners take or sit in the company of mockers, but whose delight is in the law of the Lord , and who meditates on his law day and night.
Rejoice always pray continually give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
